versions.content: The DTC-specific Amber Warning Lamp returned in the func- tion Dem_J1939DcmGetNextDTCwithLampStatus shall be set to Lamp On in case the corresponding event has assigned the Indicator referenced by DemAmber- WarningIndicatorRef and the UDS status bit 7 (WarningIndicator) is active (set to 1), otherwise it shall be set to Lamp Off.
